title: Arc Fault Detection
description: Detect residential AC arc faults from electrical current using a CNN binary classifier.
long_description: This project allows you to develop a model that is capable of classifying whether AC load current contains an arc fault, based on a single current waveform captured with a Hall-effect probe on an oscilloscope (supplied at 200 kHz), and is imagined to be incorporated into residential and appliance arc-fault monitoring. The current project only differentiates between arc and non-arc on simulated faults and many household appliances but is easily scalable to include more loads, sockets, and wiring types.
